posts.title: Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights
posts.description: Frontier LLMs can natively read and write neural network weights, past what we would expect from humans or conventional optimizers.

posts.title: Language Model “Shape”
posts.description: Some short musings on the shape of language models, e.g. what it means to design a language model around a harness, and not the other way around.

posts.title: Speculative Programmatic Tool Calling
posts.description: Speculative programmatic tool calling is a class of techniques for overlapping tool call computation with the code being generated by a harness.
